newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pepsi Gemex to pay 79.2 mln pesos total dividend.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi Gemex to pay 79.2 mln pesos total dividend.

text.p: Pepsi Gemex SA, previously known as Grupo Embotelladoras Unidas (Geupec), will pay out 79.2 million pesos from 1996 earnings, the company said Monday via local media advertisements.

Series B and L shareholders will receive 0.049 peso per share, series D limited voting shareholders will receive 0.00932 peso per share, ordinary series D shareholders will receive 0.0651 peso per share.
Holders of ordinary share certificates -- issued on the base of one series B share, one series D share and one series L share -- will receive 1.774 peso per certificate, the company added.
